propositions: Three near-identical replacement-link walkers exist across close_precheck.py and close_disposition.py that differ only in liveness check and return type, creating maintenance burden and inconsistent behavior.

The shared walk logic (duplicates outbound scan followed by supersedes inbound scan) must be consolidated into a single function with a require_live parameter while preserving class-guard differences between callers.
Existing monkeypatch seams (_has_live_replacement_link, _recorded_replacement_target, find_replacement) must retain their exact names and signatures for backward compatibility with test patches.
The reduction-failure behavior diverges between callers: live-mode walkers must return early on subject reduce failure, while _recorded_replacement_target must continue to the inbound pass.
A construct-uniqueness guard must enforce that the duplicates/supersedes walk appears in only one location (close_disposition.py) marked with a reasoned escape comment.
